title: 第7章 鸡蛋花

content_zh:
吴金凤起床后，看着在床上睡的死猪一般的周春平，脸上闪过一丝嫌恶。
这个老家伙！昨晚足足咳了半夜，让她也跟着一晚上没睡好。现在倒好，天亮了，她的睡意没了，他自己却睡的香。
自从小女儿周志美顶了周春平的班后，周春平退休在家。天天上班的人一下子空闲了下来，除了睡多点觉也没其它事做的。更不用说现在是冬季，地里没有什么活，生产队也不用出工，家家户户的都会起晚点。
周春平的慢性支气管炎，到了天亮后反而咳嗽的没那么厉害，这也是他早上不愿意早起的原因之一。
吴金凤和周春平过了大半辈子，夫妻俩平时看着是吴金凤说了算，实际上在私底下，吴金凤还是要听周春平的。
吴金凤对周春平的性格很了解。周春这人很爱面子，只要别人说多几句好话，不管他自己有没有能力帮忙，都会揽事上身。
因为周春平的这个尿性，让吴金凤的心里也积了一肚子的火。要不是多年前周春平的头脑发热，他们一家还好好地呆在大兴市做城里人。
最让吴金凤不满的是周春平的抠门。周春平每个月发了工资，都是揣在自己的兜里慢慢花，如果不是吴金凤问他讨要，他巴不得一分钱都不拿出来。
吴金凤甩了个眼刀子给床上睡的烂熟的周春平，对着镜子抿了抿鬓角散乱的头发。这么些年来，要不是他们是绑在一条绳子上的蚂蚱，光凭周春平那抠抠索索的性子，吴金凤早就和他闹翻了。
唉！一眨眼就是大半辈子啰！吴金凤轻轻叹了口气，走出房门。厨房里的饭桌上，整齐地摆放着两个白瓷的空碗和两双筷子，还有一碟炒的油汪汪的咸菜。灶台上，锅里的白粥还在冒着热气。
吴金凤满意地点了点头。
吴金凤虽然讨厌赵芸香，但心里却不得不承认赵芸香是干活的一把好手。上山下地，赵芸香在生产队里赚的公分不算少，就连家里的伙计，也是做的利利索索的。
更别说赵芸香还有一手裁缝的好手艺，自从赵芸香嫁到周家后，周家一家老老小小十几口人的衣服，都是赵芸香帮忙免费缝制的的。要是拿去镇上的裁缝做，一件衣服最少收五毛钱的加工费，做的还不如赵芸香服帖。
吴金凤老两口的一日三餐，基本上也是赵芸香煮的。自从赵芸香嫁到周家，让吴金凤最满意的就是大冬天的不用起早了。周春平在家是个大老爷们，家里的事一点都不会沾手。赵芸香没来周家之前，每天早上天刚蒙蒙亮，吴金凤就要起床做好早餐，周春平工作的粮管所在镇上，走路去要差不多一个小时。
赵芸香进门后，不管刮风下雨还是寒气彻骨，吴金凤都不用惦记着早起，赵芸香每天早上都会到大厨房先把她老两口的早餐给做好，才回自家小厨房做自己小家的早餐。吴金凤只管等着睡饱了起来就有的吃，总算享了一把婆婆福。
今天早上，吴金凤还以为会看到一个冰冷的灶台，毕竟，昨天小九那丫头出了那么大的事，赵芸香整个人也失魂落魄的，让她的心里一阵阵心虚。
苗苗那丫头是个掐尖的性子，看见小九丫头站在水边，推了一把也不是不可能的事。
可是······小九那丫头能和苗苗比吗？苗苗可是自己嫡嫡亲的孙女，小九算的了啥？
吴金凤装了碗粥坐在餐桌前，淡定地吃了起来。粥很香，咸菜也炒的恰到好处，吴金凤耷拉着的嘴角露出了一点笑意。
赵芸香还有心情帮她做早餐，小九那丫头料来已经没事了。

“奶奶奶奶，我也要吃鸡蛋花。”一个红色的身影蹦了进来，大声嚷嚷着，正是在房里躲了一晚上的周苗苗。
“哎哟喂～！吃鸡蛋？家里的鸡一天才下那么几个蛋，奶奶要留着拿去镇上换盐巴，谁这么败家要吃鸡蛋？”吴金凤的脸拉了下来。
周苗苗虽然是她最喜欢的孙女，但是，吴金凤是个很有原则的人，她心情好的时候，给你东西是一回事，但是，绝不容许有人主动向她要东西。
再说了，在这个“割尾巴”的年代，每家每户都只能养一两只鸡，吴金凤家的一只公鸡七只母鸡，已经是周家分家后四户人家的所有份额。
“奶奶，我要吃鸡蛋。凭什么周园园可以吃香喷喷的鸡蛋花，我却不可以？”周苗苗快气死了。

content_en:
After Wu Jinfeng got up, he looked at Zhou Chunping, who was sleeping like a dead pig on the bed, with a flash of disgust on his face.
This old guy! She coughed for most of the night last night, which kept her from sleeping well all night. It was better now, it was dawn, her sleepiness was gone, but he himself slept soundly.
Since his youngest daughter Zhou Zhimei took over Zhou Chunping's class, Zhou Chunping retired at home. People who work every day are suddenly free and have nothing else to do except sleep more. Not to mention that it is winter, there is no work in the fields, the production team does not have to work, and every household will get up late.
Zhou Chunping's chronic bronchitis makes his cough less severe after dawn, which is one of the reasons why he doesn't want to get up early in the morning.
Wu Jinfeng and Zhou Chunping have lived together for most of their lives. The couple usually thinks that Wu Jinfeng has the final say. In fact, in private, Wu Jinfeng still has to listen to Zhou Chunping.
Wu Jinfeng knows Zhou Chunping's character very well. Zhou Chun is a face-saving person. As long as others say a few nice words, he will do whatever he can to help, regardless of whether he has the ability to help.
Because of Zhou Chunping's urinary behavior, Wu Jinfeng was filled with anger. If it weren't for Zhou Chunping's hot-headedness many years ago, his family would still be living in Daxing City as city dwellers.
What dissatisfied Wu Jinfeng the most was Zhou Chunping's stinginess. Zhou Chunping paid his salary every month and spent it slowly in his pocket. If Wu Jinfeng hadn't asked him for it, he would have wished not to take out a penny.
Wu Jinfeng flicked his eyes at Zhou Chunping, who was sleeping on the bed, and licked his messy hair in front of the mirror. Over the years, if they hadn't been grasshoppers tied to a rope, Wu Jinfeng would have fallen out with Zhou Chunping just because of his picky temper.
well! In the blink of an eye, half of your life is gone! Wu Jinfeng sighed softly and walked out of the room. On the dining table in the kitchen, two empty white porcelain bowls, two pairs of chopsticks, and a plate of fried pickles were neatly placed. On the stove, the white porridge in the pot is still steaming.
Wu Jinfeng nodded with satisfaction.
Although Wu Jinfeng hated Zhao Yunxiang, he had to admit that Zhao Yunxiang was a good worker. Going up and down the mountains and fields, Zhao Yunxiang earned a lot of money in the production team, and even the boys at home were doing their job efficiently.
Not to mention that Zhao Yunxiang also has good tailoring skills. Since Zhao Yunxiang married into the Zhou family, the clothes for the dozen or so members of the Zhou family have been sewed for free by Zhao Yunxiang's help. If you take it to a tailor in the town to make it, they will charge at least 50 cents for processing per piece of clothing, and the clothes will not be as comfortable as Zhao Yunxiang's.
Wu Jinfeng and his wife basically had three meals a day cooked by Zhao Yunxiang. Ever since Zhao Yunxiang married into the Zhou family, Wu Jinfeng was most satisfied that she no longer had to get up early in the winter. Zhou Chunping is a big man at home and doesn't get involved in family affairs at all. Before Zhao Yunxiang came to Zhou's house, Wu Jinfeng would get up and make breakfast every morning at dawn. The grain management office where Zhou Chunping worked was in the town, and it took almost an hour to walk there.
After Zhao Yunxiang walked in, no matter it was windy, rainy or bone-chilling, Wu Jinfeng didn't have to worry about getting up early. Zhao Yunxiang would go to the big kitchen every morning to prepare breakfast for her husband and wife, and then go back to her small kitchen to make her own breakfast. Wu Jinfeng just waited for something to eat when she was full, and finally enjoyed the blessing of being a mother-in-law.
This morning, Wu Jinfeng thought she would see a cold stove. After all, something big happened to Xiaojiu yesterday, and Zhao Yunxiang was completely devastated, which made her feel guilty.
That girl Miaomiao has a very picky temper, so it's not impossible to push Xiaojiu when she saw her standing by the water.
But...can that girl Xiaojiu compare with Miaomiao? Miaomiao is his direct granddaughter, what does Xiaojiu have to do with her?
Wu Jinfeng filled a bowl of porridge and sat at the dining table, looking calmlyHe ate steadily. The porridge was very fragrant, and the pickles were fried just right. Wu Jinfeng's droopy mouth showed a little smile.
Zhao Yunxiang was still in the mood to help her make breakfast, and Xiaojiu was expected to be fine.
"Grandma, grandma, I want to eat frangipani too." A red figure jumped in and shouted loudly. It was Zhou Miaomiao who had been hiding in the room all night.
"Ouch~! Eat eggs? The chickens at home only lay so many eggs a day. Grandma wants to keep them and bring them to the town to exchange for salt. Who is so prodigal and wants to eat eggs?" Wu Jinfeng's face dropped.
Although Zhou Miaomiao is her favorite granddaughter, Wu Jinfeng is a very principled person. When she is in a good mood, it is one thing to give you things, but she will never allow anyone to take the initiative to ask for things from her.
Besides, in this "tail-cutting" era, each household can only raise one or two chickens. The Wu Jinfeng family's one rooster and seven hens are already all the shares of the four families after the Zhou family was divided.
"Grandma, I want to eat eggs. Why can Zhou Yuanyuan eat fragrant plumeria flowers, but I can't?" Zhou Miaomiao was almost furious.
